queries: WITH per_name AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_pts, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) AS cnt FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM per_name) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pts) AS avg_of_avg_points, AVG(p.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(p.cnt - o.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.cnt > o.avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: The overall average count is taken across all race names that have at least one matching standing (inner join drops standings without a race). Averages are unweighted across race names, and AVG ignores NULL points.

assumptions.assumption: Inner join of driverStandings to races on raceId drops standings with no matching race; the per-name average points is over all standings rows (AVG ignores NULLs), and the count is of distinct driverId across all years for that race name.
The overall average count is the unweighted mean of counts across race names (each name counted once).

assumptions.assumption: The average of counts is computed across all race names (after the inner join to races), as an unweighted mean of per-name distinct driver counts; the filter is strictly greater than that mean.
Per-race-name average points is the mean over all standings rows (every race/season) under that name, ignoring NULL points, which AVG does by default.
